info.title: OrderMan
info.description: Backend-only Order Management System implementing a seven-step order workflow with cached product reads, admission control, database timeout and retry, graceful degradation, and transactional integrity.

get.description: Reports whether the process is alive. Answers 200 without touching the database, so it stays available during a dependency outage.
Reports whether the service is ready for normal operations. Returns 503 with `status=not_ready` while the database is unreachable, and recovers automatically once it returns.

Reports the configured in-flight limit, the current number of admitted requests, and the peak observed since the last reset. The peak is recorded by the admission controller itself at the moment a slot is taken, so it is the authoritative measure of concurrent admission - client-observed request windows include connection setup and are not. Observation infrastructure: bypasses admission control and reads no database.
Returns in-process counters incremented at the exact site where each mechanism executes. Reads no database, so it stays available during an outage. Counters are monotonic until reset.

post.description: Available only when `ENABLE_TEST_HOOKS=true`, otherwise 404. Resets all counters, clears the application cache, and clears injected-fault state. Business data in PostgreSQL is never deleted, and no database round-trip is made, so it stays callable during an outage.
Creates a Customer synchronously and returns the created resource. `id` and `orderHistory` are server-derived and must not be supplied. `role` is fixed at creation and immutable thereafter.

get.description: Returns a Customer including its server-derived `orderHistory`.

404.description: Valid identifier but resource not found

post.description: Creates a Product synchronously. `price.amount` must carry exactly two decimal places and is rejected rather than rounded.

get.description: Searches Products by a case-insensitive substring of `description`. Passes through admission control like every public business endpoint.

Returns a Product, served from the maintained cached copy when one is fresh. During a database outage a previously warmed Product is still served from its retained copy; a never-read Product returns 503.

404.description: Valid identifier but resource not found

post.description: Creates an Order in status `PLACED`. `unitPriceSnapshot` and `totalAmount` are server-computed from current product prices. Duplicate `productRef` values are rejected with 400.

404.description: Valid identifier but resource not found

409.description: Invalid workflow state or illegal transition

get.description: Returns an Order with its line items and current workflow status.

404.description: Valid identifier but resource not found

post.description: Transitions `PLACED -> ACCEPTED`. Any other source state yields 409.

404.description: Valid identifier but resource not found

409.description: Invalid workflow state or illegal transition

post.description: Transitions `VERIFIED -> SHIPPED`. Any other source state yields 409.

404.description: Valid identifier but resource not found

409.description: Invalid workflow state or illegal transition

post.description: Transitions `SHIPPED -> CLOSED`. Any other source state yields 409.

404.description: Valid identifier but resource not found

409.description: Invalid workflow state or illegal transition

post.description: Issues an Invoice for an `ACCEPTED` Order and advances that Order to `INVOICED`, setting `invoiceRef`. Both updates occur in one transaction. `issueDate` defaults to today and `dueDate` to issueDate + 7 days.

404.description: Valid identifier but resource not found

409.description: Invalid workflow state or illegal transition

get.description: Returns an Invoice with its billing snapshot and dates in dd/MM/yyyy.

404.description: Valid identifier but resource not found

post.description: Submits a Payment against an `INVOICED` Order. The amount must exactly equal the invoice total. The Payment starts `PENDING` while the Order advances to `PAID`; both updates occur in one transaction.

404.description: Valid identifier but resource not found

409.description: Invalid workflow state or illegal transition

get.description: Returns a Payment with its current verification status.

404.description: Valid identifier but resource not found

post.description: Atomically marks the Payment `VERIFIED`, the Invoice `PAID`, and the Order `VERIFIED`. All three updates share one transaction, so a fault rolls back every one of them and returns `TRANSACTION_FAILED`.

404.description: Valid identifier but resource not found

409.description: Invalid workflow state or illegal transition

500.description: Transaction rolled back due to an internal fault
